text: Hey, peace of you all. I've doubled the UGC volume and rewrote the short drama CTA to lead with social proof. Using our creative skills, I generated 580 unique assets, each loaded with different hooks and studio grade transitions from past retention data. After the virality predictor scored the batch, three winners auto-posted across every account. Two trends surfaced across the US and Canada this week, gaining fast traction. I've added a recreation pipeline to the backlog and generated trend-aligned ads for your review. And since we cleared last week's provider issue, refund requests have dropped to zero. My recommendation, double the budget on the Street interview ad while momentum is high and let me scale the two new trend builds. What would you like me to handle first, sir?
